caption: The video captures a low, fixed view of a gray tiled floor meeting a cracked pale-yellow wall. A darker unfinished concrete column rises at the right edge. Bright sunlight throws a sharp diagonal shadow across the upper-left wall and a broad horizontal shadow band over the foreground floor. A lit strip of tile stays visible between the wall base and the shadow edge, marked by grout lines and faint blue paint spots. The camera and room geometry hold steady, with no object, person, or tile moving. The only visible change is a slow drift of the shadow boundaries as the light angle shifts. The horizontal floor edge and the diagonal wall edge creep slightly, marginally resizing the lit areas, a movement that continues without a clear beginning or end within this cropped window.
